items.definition:
a position in chess in which a player's king is directly attacked and cannot escape
With one final move, he declared checkmate.

a person who makes a comment
One commenter left a very insightful remark on the article.

a person employed in a port to load and unload ships; a software platform
The docker carefully guided the crane to unload the cargo.

a feeling of great pleasure and delight; a magical spell
The children watched the magician's tricks with enchantment.

one's native country
Soldiers are often willing to fight for their fatherland.

a person trained in forestry; a car model
The forester managed the health of the trees in the national park.

the quality of being easily broken or damaged
The fragility of the antique vase made her handle it with extreme care.

a precious or semiprecious stone, especially one cut and polished for jewelry
Sapphires and rubies are popular gemstones used in rings and necklaces.

a player whose job is to prevent the ball or puck from entering the goal
The goaltender made an incredible save in the final seconds of the game.

a valuable object that has belonged to a family for several generations
This antique watch is a family heirloom.

a person who hunts, especially with hounds
The huntsman led the dogs through the forest.

a dangerous condition in which the body loses heat faster than it can produce it
The hiker suffered from severe hypothermia after being lost in the snow.

fat from the abdomen of a pig, rendered and clarified for use in cooking
She used lard to make the pie crust flaky.

a shot or hit that sends the ball high in the air
He hit a perfect lob over the opponent's head.

a place where something happens or is set, or that has particular events associated with it
The restaurant has a charming locale by the river.

clothes for men
The department store has a large section dedicated to menswear.

a type of grain grown in warm countries
Millet is a staple food in many parts of Africa and Asia.

a false or misleading account of the truth
The company was accused of misrepresentation in its advertising.

a North American songbird noted for its mimicry
The mockingbird can imitate the songs of many other birds.

a loop with a running knot, tightening as the rope is pulled
The cowboy tied a noose in the rope for his lasso.

a new branch or development from something larger
The new company is an offshoot of a larger technology firm.

an excessive amount of something
Bringing three desserts for a small dinner party might be considered overkill.

the act of joining two things together
The wine pairing with the cheese was excellent.

the transfer of pollen
Bees are essential for the pollination of many plants.

impertinent talk; impudence
Don't give me any sass, young man!

a soft, slightly wavering light
We saw the shimmer of heat rising from the desert road.

the action or process of making something simpler or easier to understand
The new policy is a simplification of the old rules.

a sudden involuntary muscular contraction
He felt a sudden spasm in his leg.

the absence of movement or sound
The stillness of the night was broken only by the crickets.

an instance in baseball when a batter is out after three strikes
The pitcher got a strikeout to end the inning.

a cultural group within a larger culture
The punk movement was a significant subculture in the 1970s.

a horse of a breed developed in England for racing
The thoroughbred galloped gracefully around the track.

the quality of being unpleasant or unattractive
The ugliness of the graffiti marred the beautiful wall.

a tree of the birch family
The alder trees grew along the riverbank.

a large non-venomous snake found in tropical South America
The anaconda is one of the largest snakes in the world.

A person who fishes with a rod and line.
The angler patiently waited for a bite.

A person who flies an aircraft.
The aviator skillfully landed the plane in difficult conditions.

An unexpected, minor, and temporary deviation from a general trend.
The recent drop in sales is just a blip, and we expect recovery soon.

A point of congestion or obstruction.
The narrow bridge creates a bottleneck during rush hour.

A large North American reindeer.
Herds of caribou migrate across the tundra.

a medical condition in which the lens of the eye becomes progressively opaque, resulting in blurred vision.
The doctor diagnosed her with a cataract in her left eye.

a close friend.
He's been my old chum since we were kids.

a collaboration (informal).
The two artists announced a new collab on their social media.

a shelter for pigeons or other small animals.
The chickens returned to their cote at dusk.

a situation, typically one involving opposing parties, in which no agreement or decision can be reached.
The negotiations reached a deadlock, with neither side willing to compromise.

the bed on which a person dies or is dying.
He made a confession on his deathbed.

a small piece of burning or glowing coal or wood in a dying fire.
Only a few embers remained in the fireplace.

a place where a group of people are camping
The hikers set up a temporary encampment by the river.

a thing that makes two or more things equal
Education is often seen as a great equalizer in society.

a person appointed by a testator to carry out the terms of their will
My uncle was named the executor of my grandmother's will.

a flat-topped conical red hat with a black tassel, worn by Muslim men
He wore a traditional red fez on his head.

the achievement of something desired, promised, or predicted
She found great fulfilment in her volunteer work.

a band worn around the leg to keep up a stocking or sock
The bride wore a blue garter for good luck.

meaningless or unintelligible speech or writing
He was so tired he started speaking gibberish.

an ugly, repulsive old woman
The old hag lived alone in the forest.

an expression whose meaning is not predictable from the usual meanings of its constituent elements
"Break a leg" is a common English idiom.

lack of experience
Her inexperience in the role was evident.

the state of being lower in status or quality than another
He suffered from feelings of inferiority.

a person who asks questions or seeks information
The inquirer waited patiently for an answer.

the quality of being light in weight or color
The lightness of the fabric made it perfect for summer.

the action of applying a lubricant
Proper lubrication is essential for engine maintenance.

the process of making something modern
The city underwent a rapid modernisation process in the last decade.

a type of fish; a hairstyle short at the front and sides and long at the back
He decided to grow a mullet, much to his friends' amusement.

a medical device that regulates the heartbeat
His grandfather had a pacemaker fitted to help his heart.
